prompt:
Create a new KFB ink blob monster character sheet, The Semester Abroad Equation. Supplied original PNGs are style inputs for rounded ink anatomy, thick modeled lids, plasticine surface and handcrafted accessory scale. Create exactly SIX full individual upright actors in a 3-column by 2-row landscape 1536×1024 PNG with a true transparent alpha backdrop. Each actor at equal substantial scale inside their own logical cell, entire prop and all droplets inside generous transparent gutters and outer margin. No scenery, floor, labels, border, branding, joined figures or background color. Each is a dark charcoal continuous footless ink splat with subtle plum sheen and rich softly rounded clay, small goo hands, bare goo base and expressive asymmetrical organic lobes. Compact costume pieces wrap the blob. Thick filled dark lids with white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Teeth inside lips. Offbeat tourist satire, six different poses, looks and mouth shapes. Visible wear and miniature handcrafted volume. No copied eyepatches, wings, military insignia or outfits from references. Wardrobe family: mended student hoodies, clashing rain covers, old canvas and neon hostel tags. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read obsessive student traveller: upright comma, one high brow, anxious pressed lips. Prop: pocket notebook with colored tabs and a fat pencil.
2. Male-read exhausted hostel negotiator: low bean, drooping eyes, long flat mouth. Prop: battered rolled sleep mat and oversized key fob.
3. Male-read smug budget expert: round crooked cone, sideways glance, one corner raised. Prop: fat dog-eared travel guide and tiny calculator.
4. Female-read panicked exchange student: wide lobed blob, bulging eyes, asymmetric gasp. Prop: tangle of three colorful chunky plug adapters.
5. Male-read euphoric student explorer: lean bouncing blob, upturned gaze, open laugh. Prop: overfilled backpack and compact film camera.
6. Male-read disappointed backpacker: squat diamond blob, skeptical eyes, lower lip pout. Prop: miniature portable chessboard with one piece.
Emphasize eyes and acting. Keep every figure independently usable as a sightseeing bystander. Hold props close. Separate all six in clear alpha.
